# peakhour_rp_bots (Resource)

Manages RP bots configuration for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_bots" "example" {
  domain           = "example.com"
  bots_verify_rdns = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `bots_inject_js` (Boolean) Inject JS for bot detection. Set to null to clear.
- `bots_verify_invert` (Boolean) Invert bot verification logic. Set to null to clear.
- `bots_verify_list` (List of String) List of known bots to verify (spec enum). Set to null to clear.
- `bots_verify_rdns` (Boolean) Verify bots via reverse DNS. Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP bots config identifier (domain/rp_bots).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_bots.example example.com
```
